title: Bifrost privileged-operations — independent adversarial review (2026-10-19)
secrets: none (env.<NAME> references and non-secret sentinels only)
worktree: dirty (uncommitted by design; release_eligibility=BLOCKED is correct)
scope: independent re-review of the staged privilege boundary, installer, migration seed/backup/rollback path, and evidence — not a restatement of the prior report
production_mutation: none: /usr/local/lib/company-os, /usr/local/sbin/company-os-bifrost-ops and /etc/sudoers.d/company-os-bifrost-ops are all absent; live store unreadable to the reviewer (0700 company-os)

D1_installer_toctou.finding: install.sh verified SOURCE digests then copied; a local attacker writing the repo could swap bytes between verify and copy; the dispatcher's trust predicate checks ownership, not content, so a swapped-but-root-owned module would run as root.
D1_installer_toctou.fix: install.sh now re-hashes the INSTALLED bytes against SHA256SUMS after copying, before installing the sudoers rule; on any mismatch it removes the installed code (rollback_install) and exits non-zero. Sudoers is installed LAST, only after the code it authorizes is verified.

D2_backup_clobber.finding: the dispatcher's `backup` op wrote config.db.pre-restore.bak — the same path as the owner-verified rollback target — silently overwriting a verified artifact.
D2_backup_clobber.fix: the backup tool refuses to overwrite an existing backup unless --overwrite is passed; the dispatcher never passes it.

D3_rollback_digest.finding: rollback checked backup integrity_check only, not that the bytes matched the recorded digest; a valid-but-substituted db could be restored.
D3_rollback_digest.fix: rollback refuses when a manifest is available and its recorded sha256 differs from the backup; the dispatcher passes its MANIFEST path.

D4_trust_predicate.finding: the trust predicate used stat (follows symlinks) and did not check the OPS_DIR parent directory.
D4_trust_predicate.fix: _is_trusted_path now rejects symlinks ([ ! -L ]); check_trusted_set also verifies the OPS_DIR parent is root-owned/clean.

sudoers_grants_only_six_exact_invocation.evidence: deploy/sudoers.d/company-os-bifrost-ops has 6 `genie ALL=(root) NOPASSWD:` lines, no wildcard/""/ALL; test_exact_allowlist_only + test_no_wildcard_or_passthrough

no_caller_input_redirects_execution.evidence: dispatcher meta-table: only `inspect|status|backup|seed step1|step2|rollback`, exact arity, fixed paths, no env read; DispatcherMappingTests + test_environment_repo_override_is_ignored

installer_never_executes_caller_sources_.evidence: install.sh only reads/copies sources; the dispatcher never runs the repo tree

integrity_covers_every_installed_file.evidence: SHA256SUMS covers 3 modules + 2 seeds + dispatcher + sudoers; post-install verification added (D1)

no_partial_install_reports_success.evidence: set -euo pipefail; digest verify before sudoers; rollback_install removes code on mismatch; sudoers installed last

installed_tree_root_owned_not_caller_wri.evidence: install -o root -g root; trust predicate enforces owner 0 + no 022

dispatcher_fails_closed_on_bad_trust.evidence: check_trusted_set refuses (exit 2) when OPS_DIR/SEEDS/parent/files are not root-owned, symlinked, or group/world-writable

no_arbitrary_paths_or_commands.evidence: every path is a fixed constant in the dispatcher; one allowlisted token max

no_generic_root_access_via_the_six_ops.evidence: ops are fixed read/backup/seed/rollback; installed modules are stdlib-only root-owned (StdlibOnlyTests); callers supply no data

exact_binary_reverification.method: disposable copy of the reference store under /tmp/opencode; governance cleared; step2 seed applied; loopback only; production untouched
exact_binary_reverification.note: This run proves auth enforcement + preservation. True addition of a MISSING provider was shown earlier with a synthetic 'probeadd' (evidence/runs/bifrost-api-contract-2026-10-18.json t1/t2/t6).

backup_rollback_status.sidecar_handling: stale -wal/-shm removed; pre-rollback copy retained for reversibility

residual_risks: Installed bifrost_ops.py default --seed-dir points at the repo path; the dispatcher always overrides it. Only reachable if root runs the installed module directly, bypassing the dispatcher (operator action, not attacker-controlled); the seed still passes _assert_seed_safe.
The migration and rollback are NOT verified against the live database (requires the unauthorized production mutation); they are verified on disposable copies of the exact binary/store only.
The canonical backup digest could not be re-read by the reviewer (root-only); it relies on the owner-verified value and a manifest that rollback now cross-checks.
verdict: READY FOR OWNER AUTHORIZATION — with installation authorization separated from migration authorization.
